command: python -I ncd/run_aacil_retention.py --datasets UNSW-NB15 --methods aacil_iso --seeds 1 2 3 4 42 --config ncd/configs/problem_scout_section21.json --output-dir ncd/results/problem_scout/section29/retention_local_v1/unsw_nb15/aacil_iso --lambda-g 2.0 --der-alpha 1 --der-beta 1 --cbf-epochs 1 --cbf-lr-multiplier .1 --source-commit 7418b7d418f9974e88cba5dcc66c6126df117264 --deadline-iso 2026-10-19T21:50:26+08:00 --device cuda
cost_scope: training=gate+family; family=base_family+CBF (nested, not additive again); buffer_selection includes CBF subset selection; WA/prototype construction and teacher/logit/calibration/evaluation separate; excludes loading/serialization/failed attempts

effective_config.derpp_allocation_adaptation: Task-boundary AA shared attack memory and unchanged AA combined-current/retained-attack CE stream/step budget; F adds alpha stored-logit MSE and beta replay CE using two independently sampled old-memory minibatches. New retained rows store post-task G/F logits at admission; old targets are subset-retained, never refreshed. This is not online-reservoir DER++.
effective_config.derpp_coefficient_source: Section29.8 fixed alpha=beta=1; lambda grid .5/1/2 on UNSW seeds5/6
effective_config.selection_aggregation: mean seeds5/6 final validation BAcc and signed old-class forgetting
effective_config.selection_validation_policy: fixed permanent stratified10percent attack TRAIN holdout plus permanent Normal TRAIN holdout; only seen classes; evaluation only; attack holdout outside M during selection only

limitations: ISO freezes first-task encoder and learned binary heads; no router.
Exploratory Section29.8 method; fixed attack validation outside M only during selection, never optimization or test-based tuning.
Two networks and refreshed benign data are not compute-matched to one-stage baselines.
Does not close RQ1/RQ3 or establish substantive novelty.

publication_derivation.changes: Only private absolute roots in command/path metadata are normalized; original identity and all original numeric values are unchanged.
publication_derivation.checkpoint_reference_base: checkpoint_file is unchanged and resolves against the original result directory, not this publication directory; weights are not exported.

selection_rule: mean seeds5/6 final validation BAcc at least original AACIL minus .03, then minimum mean signed forgetting; candidate comparison belongs to queue

test_cil_metrics.definition: mean over all classes introduced before final task, including Normal; max earlier recall minus final recall; signed, not clipped
test_cil_metrics.units: fraction; multiply by100 for percentage/percentage points

validation_metrics.definition: mean over all classes introduced before final task, including Normal; max earlier recall minus final recall; signed, not clipped
validation_metrics.units: fraction; multiply by100 for percentage/percentage points
